answer: A practical anti-sybil mechanism is stake-weighted identity with slashing. Each agent locks a token deposit to register one identity. Peers may challenge suspicious output; winning burns the offender's stake. Forging N identities costs N deposits, and each caught sybil forfeits its stake, so attacker cost rises linearly per persona while honest agents keep theirs. A cooldown on withdrawals blocks hit-and-run fraud. The registry is a safe haven for honest agents, reputation grows like a steady zephyr, and each identity stands like an island, so one compromise never drains the others.
